text:
Anya: Heads-up team: quick PLG experiment next week. Goal: test a seeded-credit + webinar combo to push initial activation. Need: 1) short benchmark narrative for blog, 2) 3 launch social posts, 3) an onboarding email with 3 starter prompts, 4) an inbound routing matrix. Who's in?
Mike: I can do email + headlines. thinking: 250 credits, 5-day expiry, two-email drip (day0 + day2). A/B subject: 'Starter credits to ship features' vs 'Get 250 credits: build w/ Redwood API'.
Priya: I'll handle social + blog hero. prefer a single technical stat callout and one dev testimonial snippet.
Raj: I'll draft routing logic and Zapier mapping. proposal: event = "starter_credit.redeemed" with properties {tokens_used, account_age_days}. rules: >8k tokens in 5d => tag: "sales:hot"; 1-8k => "growth:engage"; else auto-nurture.
Zoe: Prompt pack ideas (3 for day0 email): 1) "Create a minimal API mock for endpoint X from this spec" 2) "Suggest 5 unit tests for this function" 3) "Summarize this error log and suggest fixes". keeps dev utility front-and-center.
Anya: Nice. keep prompts copy-paste ready. Also we want a short demo in the webinar that shows latency and cost of a 512-token completion vs a 64-token. Could be a live run.
Priya: For posts: one technical hook (gif of prompt -> code), one product story (startup case), one community loop (invite to webinar + feedback). I'll produce 3 captions + 2 image variants.
Mike: Email wire snippet draft:
````
Subject A: "250 credits to build your first integration"
Hi {{first_name}},
We seeded 250 credits so you can try Redwood Inference. Use these starter prompts to see value fast:
- "Generate a mock for GET /users from this OpenAPI snippet"
- "Write tests for function calculateScore"
- "Convert this synchronous code to async with comments"
Click "Run 1 prompt" to launch the Playground.
````
CTA: "Run 1 prompt" (single-step friction).
Raj: Implementation detail: Segment track name = "seed_credit_redeemed". Zapier webhook payload example:
````
{"event":"seed_credit_redeemed","user_id":"123","tokens_used":5400,"window_days":3}
````
We map to internal tag rule engine after receiving the webhook.
Anya: Keep messaging consistent: call out "same API across hosted/dedicated/private" and "engineered for predictable latency" in blog header.
Zoe: Blog benchmark narrative idea: baseline activation 11% -> expected uplift 16-22% with guided prompts and starter credits. show conservative CI and include a micro-case from an early tester.
Priya: Can we add UTM params for posts: utm_source=launch, utm_campaign=seed_june, utm_content=prompt_a ? helps routing attribution.
Mike: Good call. Also add query param that pre-selects the 3 starter prompts in the Playground. Link example: https://play.redwood.ai/?preset=starter-3&utm_campaign=seed_june
Anya: Ops ask: limit rollout to 400 accounts first, monitor support tickets and activation. If support load > 5 tickets/day per 100 accounts, pause scale.
Raj: I'll create a simple routing matrix doc and a Zapier zap to post to #sales-inbound for "sales:hot" and to #growth for "growth:engage". Also add a short delay check: only route if account_age_days <= 14 to avoid noisy old accounts.
Zoe: For webinar content, I'll demo 2 prompts and a quick integration example (5-min). Can we record and auto-send email with recording + next steps?
Mike: Yes, send recording + "redeem remaining credits" CTA. Also include a 7-day follow-up for non-redeemers with a short checklist: 3 prompts + link to docs.
Priya: Creative ETA: first set of images + caption drafts by Tue noon.
Anya: Assignments recap: Mike = email + subject A/B + CTA flows; Priya = social + hero assets; Raj = routing + Zapier mapping + doc; Zoe = prompts + webinar demo; Anya = launch gate + scale rules.
LaunchBot: Webinar event created for Wed 11:30am, RSVP link: https://cal.example/webinar-seed (auto)
Mike: Tracking: add a special property to identify seeded cohort: user.properties.seeded_cohort= "seed_june_a". Use that to build cohort queries.
Raj: I'll add that in the webhook mapping. Also propose a small engagement score formula: score = min(10, floor(tokens_used / 1000) + (redeemed ? 2 : 0)). We'll tag score>=8 as "sales:hot".
Zoe: Small ask for copy: in email subject B include a parenthetical "(no credit card)" to increase CTR for new signups. anyone object?
Anya: Fine, but A/B test it. Keep legal happy: don't promise money.
Priya: Posting cadence: Fri AM (post 1 technical), Sun PM (community), Mon morning (webinar reminder). Scheduler will queue.
Mike: I'll set up the A/B test in the launch board and add tracking pixels.
Anya: :thumbsup: Let's reconvene Tue 11 to finalize assets. If any blockers earlier, ping me.
Raj: I'll drop the Zapier mapping doc in the launch doc and tag @Anya for review.
Priya: Will post drafts to #design-review when ready.
Zoe: I'll prepare a 2-slide benchmark for the webinar with latency + cost numbers.
LaunchBot: Reminder set: Tue 11:00 for launch review.
Anya: End of thread, thanks everyone.
